summary: Completed backend (pytest, 17 tests) and frontend (Playwright) testing for Cranmore Carpenters QA. All backend endpoints (auth, dashboard, tracker, visis list/detail, step toggle with task-evidence enforcement, override w/ comment enforcement, attachment upload+serve) return correct status and data. Frontend: admin login -> dashboard shows all 6 metric cards + 3 breakdown charts; Multi-Template Tracker renders columns grouped by company->template with column totals and 14 rows x 9 columns of x/y progress cells + Excel export button; sidebar tree expands and location navigation works; LocationDetail Visis tab lists 59 visis and rows open the VisiModal (steps + details panel + activity); QR export dialog renders. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Downloads file WITHOUT enforcing authentication - the `authorization`/`auth` header/query is parsed but never validated (request_token stub returns None and no check is performed). Any unauthenticated caller who knows the storage_path can retrieve the file bytes.

Seed data sets `visible_to: <all company ids>` on every visi, so the trade user (Crema) sees all 154 visis. The filter logic itself is correct, but the seed makes the visibility scoping effectively a no-op — reduce visible_to in seed_data.py to make scoping meaningful.

Lockout uses `count>=5` but ALSO refreshes locked_until on every subsequent failed attempt; count is never reset after the 15-min window expires, so once at 5 failures a user is permanently locked without manual DB cleanup. Consider resetting count after window expiration.
`allow_origins` includes only FRONTEND_URL and localhost, but CORS_ORIGINS env var is defined and ignored. Works today because FRONTEND_URL is set correctly; still a config inconsistency.

issues: Radix DialogContent used without DialogTitle -> a11y console error 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle'. Wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle for screen readers.

action_items: Enforce auth in GET /api/files/{path} (validate JWT from ?auth= query or Authorization header before serving).
Fix seed_data.py: don't set visible_to = all companies, otherwise Crema sees every visi (permission scoping is untestable in UI).
Reset login_attempts.count once the 15-min lockout window expires, otherwise permanent lockout.
Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to Radix Dialogs to remove a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `/api/files/{path}` has dead auth code (`request_token` stub) - file serve is effectively public.
server.py L748 CORSMiddleware ignores CORS_ORIGINS env, uses hardcoded FRONTEND_URL fallback.
seed_data.py L164 `visible_to: list(comps.values())` makes visibility filter a no-op.
server.py is 770 lines in a single file; consider splitting into auth/visis/attachments/dashboard routers for maintainability.
Login lockout logic doesn't reset after window expiry (permanent block once tripped).
